adjudication.rationale: In `admin-group.js.es6` the `addMembers` action contains an explicit `// TODO: should clear the input` and does not reset `this.get("usernames")` after `this.get("model").addMembers(...)` succeeds, so the UX/state remains stale. Also, both `addMembers` and `removeMember` simply return the underlying AJAX promise (`Group.addMembers` / `Group.removeMember`) without any `.catch`/error-path handling, so failures (e.g., 422 from the new admin endpoints in `Admin::GroupsController#add_members`/`#remove_member`) would not be surfaced/handled in the controller. This is a concrete, diff-grounded robustness/flow completeness concern, but not a verifiable functional break introduced by the diff (UI also hides these actions for `automatic` groups).
